I've had stomach problems for a long time, and I was a functioning alcoholic for a long time, so I feel I'm qualified to answer this.

1) Never be without stomach meds. Pepto, Tums, Tums Complete (the ones with Famotidine in them...Famotidine is systemic antacid). The only reason I bring a backpack everywhere is to carry meds.

2) Always have a snack nearby, preferably something starchy like chips or crackers. I like pretzels. They absorb acid and solid food calms nausea. Eat a bit between each drink. Good strategy for bingeing.

3) Learn to like milk. I grew up with it, but I understand some people didn't. It's filling, soothing, and neutralizes weak acid. And it's tasty. Chug some down whenever you go outside for a cigarette.

4) When all else fails, a teaspoon of baking soda in a glass of water will neutralize any acid and calm your stomach. Don't overdo it.

And finally, 5) Don't be afraid to throw up. Sometimes you just need to clear your stomach and start over. You'll feel much better afterwards.
